{{Top}}
A '''pneumatic projectile cannon''' was a weapon that fired a projectile using pneumatic pressure. It was commonly found on the civilian version of the [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]].

==Appearances==
*{{Film|IV}} {{1st}} {{C|Model only}}
